precedence: V12_OPUS_M2_FINAL_GATE §4.1 overrides padded V11 H1/4:5 framing. Editorial crops are separate, never physical-scale H1.

family_capture.camera: Single setup: same camera height, lens, distance, orientation, daylight/studio lighting and colour-management across all four packs.
family_capture.ground: Transparent alpha preferred; #f7f7f5 accepted only with approved tight silhouette extents.
family_capture.crop: Tight silhouette on all four sides; highest point at y=0; physical contact point at y=height-1; no empty margins, clipping, diffuse shadow padding or baked page UI.
family_capture.shadow: Contact shadow inside silhouette bounds only; do not enlarge bbox for cast shadow.
family_capture.compositing: Photograph exact FINAL-v5 packs preferred. If generated geometry/background is used, remove all generated label pixels and composite exact supplied approved FINAL-v5 artwork as an immutable layer with real cylindrical/perspective wrapping. Never redraw text, hallucinate glyphs, retouch spelling or recolour from CSS swatches. Current gate forbids substituting old renders. Any generated/composited result still needs independent physical/label approval.
family_capture.materials: Matte/soft-touch pack body; Moisturizer and SPF actual pump/actuator MATTE, never gloss. Transparent protective cap must follow verified pack, do not infer its finish.
family_capture.print_colour: Pantone U targets from BRAND_MANIFEST, confirmed against physical pack; CSS tokens are provisional, never colour targets.
family_capture.label_checks: Exact proper names, actives, promise, suitability, size (200 mL / 30 mL / 50 gm / 50 gm), white identity geometry and complete back/INCI from FINAL-v5. Old photographed Cleanser/Serum labels are forbidden.
family_capture.export: Genuine WebP encoded sRGB with alpha or matching ground, no metadata dependency; H1 portrait silhouette height 2400 px with actual measured width. Retain lossless compositing master.
family_capture.approval_receipt: Record original artwork file + SHA256, output SHA256, width/height, silhouette extents/contact row, reviewer/date and separate label/material/crop signoffs. All approval defaults false; production file reference remains null until signed off.

integration: Files delivery is content work: create approved bts_media entries and link each product-content media_front in a later authorized operation. The existing real image_url/image_tag path consumes references; filenames alone never enable media. No code change required for approved H1 files. All four approved crops plus existing sourced measurements enable measured shelf.
